column1: mutated_339,"Develop a Python function named `update_and_retrain_model` that dynamically loads a machine learning model from a specified serialized file (supporting formats like `pickle`, `joblib`, `onnx`), updates its hyperparameters based on user input and real-time data from an external API, and re-trains the model using a provided dataset. The function must efficiently handle large datasets and integrate seamlessly with an existing microservices architecture, managing dependencies on external services and ensuring minimal impact on service performance.
- The function needs to authenticate and securely access an external API to fetch hyperparameter updates.
